objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-user-execution-malicious-url-shortcut-file
objects.description: The following analytic detects the creation URL shortcut files, often used by malware like CHAOS ransomware. It leverages the Endpoint.Filesystem datamodel to identify ".url" files created outside common directories, such as "Program Files".
